items.title: Lionel Hampton interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: I had Johnny Hodges at one time... Johnny Hodges played a lead solo on it [Sunny Side of the Street].

ctx.x: They did a terrific job on that. And a whole lot of guys. I had Johnny Hodges at one time.
Oh, gee. You picked guys from the Basie band to come in and then from the Ellington band.
